PRIVACY & PREVIEW INFORMATION

Your plans stay
in this page.

The planning form is a local demonstration. It does not submit your information to SUKHA or send an email.

How the preview works

Entries remain in the current page while you use the form. They are not stored by the form in cookies or browser storage. You can generate a summary and choose to copy it to your clipboard. Reloading or leaving the page clears the entries.

Optional contact fields

Use sample details while reviewing the prototype. No travel designer will receive these entries, and no booking or inquiry is created.

Site delivery

The hosting platform may process ordinary access information to deliver the website. The interface does not add marketing analytics or tracking pixels. A complete business privacy notice, data controller details and retention policy are required before live inquiries are enabled.

Photography & product information

The homepage Great Wall photograph is illustrative destination photography from Unsplash. Abstract route illustrations are editorial artwork, not photographs of trains, cabins, ships or wildlife experiences.
